_about: Flags to create in Flagsmith (project 'prasthan', environments 'development' + 'production'). Config only, not code. Session C writes scripts/flagsmith-import.ts at hack time (see codex/C-01-flagsmith-import.md); if the import fails, create these by hand in the dashboard in this order. Every flag also has a coded default in the API (same values) so the app works when Flagsmith is unreachable.
_types: boolean = on/off with no value. remote_config = on/off + a value (string | number | json). Flagsmith stores values as strings/ints/bools; JSON values are stored as a string and parsed with getValue(..., {json:true}) or JSON.parse.

segments.name: tamil_travellers
segments.rules: role = traveller AND home_state = Tamil Nadu

segments.name: gifting_pilot_20pct
segments.rules: role = traveller AND % split 20 (Flagsmith 'percentage split' operator on identity)

flags.name: festival_mode
flags.why: Stage switch #1: change the festival from the dashboard, app theme + greeting change live. Tamil travellers see Pongal mode from the same code.

flags.name: route_config
flags.why: Which routes are live and featured, without a deploy.

flags.name: surge_warning
flags.why: Thresholds for fare-surge and tout warnings. We never show prices; the multiplier comes from the alerts feed (seeded or context.dev news).

flags.name: special_service_announcements
flags.why: Ops can push an announcement banner (e.g. 'Special train Bengaluru -> Patna on 13 Jan') as remote config. The API merges it into /v1/alerts.

flags.name: voice_enabled
flags.why: Master kill switch for live voice. Off = text box + tap-to-pick sample sentences.

flags.name: voice_fallback_offline
flags.why: THE NudgeBee bridge. On = skip live Sarvam calls: replies use pre-recorded/cached audio + text, intent parsing uses the rule-based parser. NudgeBee runbook (or /v1/ops/fallback) turns it on when the voice pod is down.

flags.name: tts_model
flags.why: Model routing without a deploy. Default may be switched to bulbul:v4-flash on the day after a test; Odia stays on v3 (v4 Flash has no Odia per the kit; UNVERIFIED that v3 has Odia).

flags.name: tts_speaker
flags.why: Speaker per model. Speaker ids from the kit (v3: shubh, priya, aditya, simran). Confirm on the Sarvam Voices page at 10:00 and update here.

flags.name: stt_mode
flags.why: Saaras v4 mode: transcribe | codemix | translate. Code-mixed Kannada-English is the common case.

flags.name: gifting_enabled
flags.why: Stage switch #3: staged rollout. 20% of travellers get the gift add-on, then flip to 100% live. CUT FIRST if time is short.

flags.name: operator_add_service
flags.why: Only bus operators see the 'Add a bus' button.

flags.name: shop_orders_view
flags.why: Only sweet shops see the orders-per-pickup-point view.

flags.name: quick_commerce_view
flags.why: CUT FIRST. One dashboard view on seeded data for quick-commerce partners.

flags.name: live_data_source
flags.why: 'seeded' | 'context_dev'. Picks where the alerts feed comes from. Keep 'seeded' for the stage demo unless the live search was tested that day.

flags.name: deep_link_providers
flags.why: Order and set of booking links per mode. Drop a provider live if its link breaks.

flags.name: alert_poll_seconds
flags.why: How often the app polls /v1/alerts and /v1/config. Ops can slow clients down during the rush.

flags.name: reply_style
flags.why: Optional A/B: warm vs short voice reply. Log which variant each reply used (own event log); Flagsmith Experimentation is beta and maybe not on Free. Skip if short on time.
